subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Capable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Incompetent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Capable"** refers to someone or something having the ability, skill, or competence to do something successfully. (सक्षम)
 
 
• **Example:** She is capable of handling complex situations with ease.
 
 

 
• **"Incompetent"** means lacking the ability or skill to do something successfully. It is the opposite of being capable. (अयोग्य)
 
 
• **Example:** He proved to be incompetent at managing the team effectively.
 
 

 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Capable"** is **"Incompetent"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Incompetent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Considerate** (विचारशील): Showing careful thought and concern for the feelings of others.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very considerate, always ensuring everyone feels included.
 
 

 
• **Garrulous** (बातूनी): Excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters.
 
 
• **Example:** His garrulous nature often leads to long, unnecessary conversations.
 
 

 
• **Troublesome** (परेशानी देने वाला): Causing difficulty or annoyance.
 
 
• **Example:** The troublesome child disrupted the entire class.
 
 

3a:T930,

The correct answer is **option 4.**
